name: Elijah Connor Snyder
source: A womanizer and drinker, he likes to go to the bar after a long day. He likes to keep up the dark and mysterious image. Despite his “no fucks given” attitude, he is actually a hard worker. He can be rather short tempered and quick to fight. He acts as a mentor to Chuckles and pretty much helped him get into being a serial killer and rapist.
